BetScout — Notification Cards Design Catalog

Complete catalog of all high-resolution notification card designs generated by BetScout for Discord & Telegram syndication (featuring the 3D Chiseled Bevel Compass emblem, multi-color sport icons, muted "vs" matchup typography, two-line KPI split boxes, and settled score recaps).

Part I · Multi-Row Slate Boards (1180px Wide — Morning Digest & Settled Recaps)

11 · Daily High-Conviction Multi-Sport Slate Board (Morning Digest)

Published automatically at 09:00 CET and via the Share Picks modal for multi-pick slates across all 10 sports.

12 · Automated Settled Paper-Bet Recap Board (Resolved Results & Ledger ROI)

Published automatically when matches finish and settle, showing 2-line Matchup + Final Score, unit PnL, and cumulative W-L record.

Part II · Single Match & Alert Cards (1080×560px — All 10 Archetypes)

1 · Football Pre-Match High-Conviction Pick (Dixon-Coles 28-Score Matrix)

Sent for qualifying football picks passing the 7-factor composite + T-60m Starting XI safety gate.

2 · ATP / WTA Tennis Banker Pick (Markov Set-Score Matrix)

Sent for high-probability tennis bankers passing Surface Elo, 6m Game-Win%, rest/turnaround, and drift gates.

3 · NBA Basketball Quantitative Edge (Shooting & Possession Gate)

Sent when NBA composite score >= 0.16 and the 3PT Volume & Turnover-Security safety gate passes.

4 · NHL Ice Hockey Edge (Goalie Save% & Shot Volume Gate)

Sent for NHL matchups backed by rolling Goalie Save%, shot-on-goal differential, and rest advantage.

5 · NFL American Football Edge (Yards-Per-Play & Turnover Margin)

Sent for NFL selections where net Yards-Per-Play (YPP), third-down efficiency, and Elo align.

6 · Table Tennis Session Banker (Cold-Session Rust Gate Verified)

Sent for Table Tennis favorites with verified active <48h session rhythm and chronological Last-3 form edge.

7 · Bookmaker Odds Mispricing Dislocation Alert (EDGE ≥ +2.0pp)

Triggered when BetScout's calibrated model win probability exceeds the vig-free market line by >= +2.0pp.

8 · Sharp Closing-Line Steam Move Alert (CLV ≥ +3.0%)

Sent when bookmaker odds shorten sharply after BetScout logs a pick, confirming institutional steam.

9 · High-Probability Banker Profitability Booster (2-Leg & 3-Leg Combo)

Combines 2 or 3 high-win-probability (>=72%), lower-odds bankers into a high-yielding multiplier ticket.

10 · Live In-Play Dominance Rebound & Late-Goal Alert (Cyan Top Border)

Triggered in real time when a backed pre-match favorite is level/trailing despite dominating live Shots-on-Target.

11 · Resolved Single Pick Recap — WIN (Green Top Border)

Published when a tracked pick settles as a WIN, featuring a Green top border and realized unit profit.

12 · Resolved Single Pick Recap — LOSS (Red/Pink Top Border)

Published when a tracked pick settles as a LOSS, featuring a Red/Pink top border and crimson result box.
